primary_source.title: Matrix Profile I: All Pairs Similarity Joins for Time Series
primary_source.claim_boundary: The matrix profile records each subsequence's nearest-neighbor distance and its maxima encode discords. v14 is a fixed causal finite past-dictionary approximation with prefix-global scaling, not the exact all-pairs algorithm and not a source-derived P1 performance claim.

mechanism.evidence: Yeh et al. define the profile as nearest-neighbor subsequence distance and connect maxima to discords.

p1_novelty.evidence: No executed P1 Matrix Profile/discord/nearest-subsequence implementation exists; the academic audit rejects standard per-subsequence z-normalization but explicitly leaves an unnormalized candidate-local drift variant for later.

transport_risk.evidence: The v13 station-layer x chronological-half veto is frozen before v14 execution; pooled inner LCB alone cannot seal a threshold.

deep_research_gap_matrix.limitation: A 16-member fixed lagged dictionary is only a causal approximation to all-pairs Matrix Profile and may miss more distant motifs. No result-driven dictionary/window expansion is allowed.

semantic_audit.standard_matrix_profile: The prior P1 NO-GO applies to per-subsequence z-normalization, which erases additive offsets. v14 uses one prefix-fitted station-layer robust center/scale and never recenters query or dictionary subsequences individually.
semantic_audit.v10_recurrence: v10 compares scalar states at fixed lags and recurrence radii. v14 compares whole nonoverlapping subsequences and takes nearest/second/median dictionary distances in both level and derivative geometry.
semantic_audit.minirocket: MiniRocket uses fixed convolutions and PPV/max features. v14 performs nearest-neighbor subsequence matching with no kernels or PPV.
semantic_audit.hsmm: Typed duration/factorial semi-Markov implementations already exist and were rejected as duplicates; v14 has no duration grammar or decoder.
semantic_audit.proposal_rescore: Long-event rescore classifies frozen proposals. v14 is a rowwise causal representation and creates no event proposal family.
semantic_audit.closed_recent_axes: Wavelet, recurrence, MMD, and visibility encode frequency energy, state recurrence, distribution embedding, and order-obstruction topology respectively; none performs nearest full-subsequence dictionary matching.

representation.normalization: single prefix-fitted robust station-layer center and scale
